trial: C7 identity of the mesenchymal-sort contaminant

rules.question: item A1: which mutant epithelial state is the contaminant of the mesenchymal sort
rules.query: cluster 11 at leiden_0.5 in the C1b mesenchyme object
rules.control: cluster 14, the cleanest fibroblast cluster in the same object
rules.reference: RFP-sorted epithelium of GSE316244, both genotypes, processed as in trial C2
rules.gene_space: GSE316241 and GSE316244 share a gene space exactly (C0), so no intersection is needed
rules.confidence_floor: reported, never used to exclude a cluster; C1 and C2 showed that floor discarding the populations under test
rules.comparison_genes: detected in at least 10% of the query or of one reference cluster; mt, ribo and hb genes excluded
rules.T1: Spearman of the query mean profile against each reference cluster mean profile; highest names the state
rules.T2: the query cells scored directly with the same marker sets, modal call
rules.T3: control: cluster 11 must beat cluster 14 by at least 0.1 rho, or T1 and T2 get no reading

reading_fixed_in_advance.DATP_like: the contaminant is the paper's own signalling population; the finding-one caution is sharper
reading_fixed_in_advance.AT2_or_AT1_like: the leak is ordinary alveolar epithelium; the caution is milder
reading_fixed_in_advance.Cd177_positive_or_cycling: an unexpected state, reported with no further reading
reading_fixed_in_advance.control_failed: the measure reads depth or ambient signal, not identity; no reading

caveats: 184 query cells; a profile comparison, not a test between groups
about one query cell in five co-detects Krt8 and Col1a1 (C5), a doublet minority

results.reading: the leak is ordinary alveolar epithelium; the caution is milder The two routes disagree: profile correlation says AT1_like and direct scoring says DATP_like, so neither is read as settled.
